about: Added 2026-10-21 after Nackers' firsthand account. Does not replace rack1-events.json. Pocket IDs per Nackers for this recording, camera view: P1 far-left corner, P2 near-left corner, P3 near side, P4 near-right corner, P5 far-right corner, P6 far side. Pockets checked by Claude from video frames; 'evidence' = what the system had.

correction.now: two-rail kick: left short rail ~38.9 s, near long rail ~39.65 s, then the 1 ~39.9 s (agrees with Nackers)

pockets.note: body covers the area just after the drop

nackersAccount: 2 two-rail kick at the 1, hits side-pocket jaw, stays out
3 makes the 1 in the side; cue two rails, contacts the 6, hooked on the 2
4 one-rail kick at the 2, missed top corner
6 makes the 2 top corner; cue one rail, contacts the 6, hooked on the 3
7 one-rail kick, 3 and 5 nearly simultaneous, quite confident 5 first; 5 in side pocket, 3 one rail toward foot spot
9 makes the 4 top corner, mostly obscured by body
10 makes the 6 in side, three rails
